FIELDS.NAME: SureBuild Supplies Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SureBuild Supplies Co. specializes in the wholesale distribution of quality building materials and supplies tailored for the construction industry. Our operations include sourcing a wide range of products such as lumber, drywall, roofing materials, and various construction tools. We ensure that all materials meet local, state, and federal safety requirements while adhering to stringent inventory management practices to track stock levels effectively. Our facilities feature adequate fire prevention measures, including documented protocols for both building and outdoor storage areas. With a strong focus on safety, we conduct regular audits and training for our staff to maintain high safety standards and mitigate risks. Furthermore, our logistics operations are designed to ensure secure transit of materials, with protocols in place to protect against theft or loss. By fostering strong vendor relationships, we ensure timely deliveries while maintaining operational efficiency, all aimed at providing our customers with the highest quality service possible.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 04/15/2023; Cause: Theft of inventory during overnight hours; Amount: $2,500; Status: Claim filed and under review. Loss dates: 08/22/2023; Cause: Water damage from a leaky roof; Amount: $750; Status: Repaired and resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel security vault, Class 1, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fenced perimeter with adequate lighting and security cameras installed. Regular inspections conducted to ensure safety and security measures are effective.
